# What's new in 1.2.7

- Take pictures inside JobTracker, with a preview, Retake, and Use photo. The Photos editor now has a simpler layout and clearer controls.
- Recover deleted jobs and drafts from the Recycle bin at the bottom of Settings. Photos, costs, and draft progress are preserved; permanent deletion asks for confirmation.
- Keep up to three drafts, open them from Home, and swipe them to delete.
- Choose which jobs, drafts, and details to sync with another phone. Costs are off by default and can be selected separately for each job.
- Turn on the optional long-swipe setting to skip confirmation when swiping more than 70% left. Deleted items go to the Recycle bin.
- Swipe a job right to move it to the top of the list. History is now an icon in the top-right corner of Home.
- Use the improved job sharing menu and choose QR or PDF sharing options in Settings.
- Phone numbers are easier to read while typing, and prices use dollar formatting.
- The release app checks for updates silently when opened. Failed checks wait until the next opening.
- The QR scanner has a cleaner Back button and no red scan line.

**Sync phones:** Update both phones to 1.2.7 or newer before syncing. Older versions use a different sync format. QR sharing still excludes photos and costs.
